  best_word : text
  best_count : int
  counts : map of text to int
end tracker

unit step_tracker
  why "update best word if current word has strictly greater count"
  takes cur : tracker
  takes w : text
  gives tracker
  s0: cnt = map.get_or cur.counts w 0
  s1: better = cnt > cur.best_count
  s2: nw = when better then w else cur.best_word
  s3: nc = when better then cnt else cur.best_count
  s4: res = new tracker best_word = nw, best_count = nc, counts = cur.counts
  s5: give res
end step_tracker

unit most_common_word
  why "the word that occurs most often in lower case with alphabetical tie breaking"
  takes t : text
  gives text
  example "apple banana apple cherry" gives "apple"
  example "banana apple" gives "apple"
  example "" gives ""
  s0: low = text.lower t
  s1: words = text.split_words low
  s2: empty = seq.is_empty words
  s3: give "" when empty
  s4: counts = seq.tally words
  s5: keys = map.keys counts
  s6: sorted_keys = seq.sort keys
  s7: start = new tracker best_word = "", best_count = -1, counts = counts
  s8: final = seq.fold sorted_keys start with step_tracker
  s9: ans = final.best_word
  s10: give ans
end most_common_word

unit find_prefix
  why "finds the longest candidate prefix that every word starts with"
  takes words : seq of text
  takes candidate : text
  takes len : int
  gives text
  shrinks len
  s0: give "" when len <= 0
  s1: ok = seq.all words with text.starts_with candidate
  s2: give candidate when ok
  s3: less = len - 1
  s4: shorter = text.take candidate less
  s5: out = find_prefix words shorter less
  s6: give out
end find_prefix

unit longest_common_prefix
  why "the longest text that every word starts with"
  takes words : seq of text
  gives text
  s0: empty = seq.is_empty words
  s1: give "" when empty
  s2: first_opt = seq.first words
  s3: first = maybe.or first_opt ""
  s4: len = text.length first
  s5: prefix = find_prefix words first len
  s6: give prefix
end longest_common_prefix

unit reverse_words
  why "give the words of the text in opposite order, separated by single spaces"
  takes t : text
  gives text
  example "hello world" gives "world hello"
  s0: words = text.split_words t
  s1: rev = seq.reverse words
  s2: out = text.join rev " "
  s3: give out
end reverse_words

unit fib_step
  takes count : int
  takes a : int
  takes b : int
  gives int
  shrinks count
  s0: give a when count <= 0
  s1: less = count - 1
  s2: next = a + b
  s3: res = fib_step less b next
  s4: give res
end fib_step

unit fibonacci
  takes n : int
  gives int
  example 10 gives 55
  s0: res = fib_step n 0 1
  s1: give res
end fibonacci

record gcd_state
  a : int
  b : int
end gcd_state

unit gcd_step
  takes s : gcd_state
  gives loop of gcd_state and int
  s0: give loop.done s.a when s.b == 0
  s1: rem = s.a % s.b
  s2: next = new gcd_state a = s.b, b = rem
  s3: step = loop.again next
  s4: give step
end gcd_step

unit gcd
  takes a : int
  takes b : int
  gives int
  example 0 0 gives 0
  example 12 8 gives 4
  example 5 0 gives 5
  example 0 5 gives 5
  example 7 13 gives 1
  s0: start = new gcd_state a = a, b = b
  s1: ans = repeat start with gcd_step limit 200 else 0
  s2: give ans
end gcd

unit count_distinct
  why "how many different values are in xs"
  takes xs : seq of int
  gives int
  example [1, 2, 2, 3, 1] gives 3
  example [] gives 0
  s0: unique = seq.distinct xs
  s1: count = seq.length unique
  s2: give count
end count_distinct

unit shift_code
  why "shift a single character code if it is a lowercase letter"
  takes c : int
  takes shift : int
  gives int
  s0: is_lower = c >= 97 and c <= 122
  s1: offset = c - 97
  s2: new_offset = (offset + shift) % 26
  s3: shifted = 97 + new_offset
  s4: out = when is_lower then shifted else c
  s5: give out
end shift_code

unit caesar_shift
  why "shift lowercase letters by k places wrapping around"
  takes t : text
  takes k : int
  gives text
  example "abc xyz!" 1 gives "bcd yza!"
  s0: mod1 = k % 26
  s1: mod2 = mod1 + 26
  s2: shift = mod2 % 26
  s3: codes = text.codes t
  s4: shifted = seq.each codes with shift_code shift
  s5: out = text.from_codes shifted
  s6: give out
end caesar_shift

record prime_state
  d : int
  n : int
end prime_state

unit check_divisor
  why "test whether st.d divides st.n, stepping by 2"
  takes st : prime_state
  gives loop of prime_state and bool
  s0: q = st.n / st.d
  s1: stop = st.d > q
  s2: divides = st.n % st.d == 0
  s3: step = st.d + 2
  s4: next = new prime_state d = step, n = st.n
  s5: out = when stop then loop.done true else when divides then loop.done false else loop.again next
  s6: give out
end check_divisor

unit is_prime
  why "is n a prime number"
  takes n : int
  gives bool
  example 7 gives true
  s0: give false when n < 2
  s1: give true when n == 2
  s2: rem = n % 2
  s3: give false when rem == 0
  s4: start = new prime_state d = 3, n = n
  s5: res = repeat start with check_divisor limit n else false
  s6: give res
end is_prime

record rle_state
  current_char : text
  count : int
  acc : text
end rle_state

unit rle_step
  why "step for run-length encoding fold"
  takes s : rle_state
  takes ch : text
  gives rle_state
  s0: is_empty = s.count == 0
  s1: same = ch == s.current_char
  s2: count_text = int.to_text s.count
  s3: enc_prev = text.concat s.current_char count_text
  s4: new_acc = text.concat s.acc enc_prev
  s5: next_count = s.count + 1
  s6: state_first = new rle_state current_char = ch, count = 1, acc = s.acc
  s7: state_same = new rle_state current_char = ch, count = next_count, acc = s.acc
  s8: state_diff = new rle_state current_char = ch, count = 1, acc = new_acc
  s9: out = when is_empty then state_first
      else when same then state_same
      else state_diff
  s10: give out
end rle_step

unit run_length_encode
  why "run-length encode the text"
  takes t : text
  gives text
  example "aaabcc" gives "a3b1c2"
  example "" gives ""
  s0: chars = text.chars t
  s1: start = new rle_state current_char = "", count = 0, acc = ""
  s2: final = seq.fold chars start with rle_step
  s3: give "" when final.count == 0
  s4: count_text = int.to_text final.count
  s5: last_run = text.concat final.current_char count_text
  s6: out = text.concat final.acc last_run
  s7: give out
end run_length_encode

record counted_word
  word : text
  count : int
end counted_word

unit to_counted
  takes w : text
  takes counts : map of text to int
  gives counted_word
  s0: c = map.get_or counts w 0
  s1: cw = new counted_word word = w, count = c
  s2: give cw
end to_counted

unit better_word
  takes best : counted_word
  takes item : counted_word
  gives counted_word
  s0: pick = when item.count > best.count then item else best
  s1: give pick
end better_word

unit most_common_word
  takes t : text
  gives text
  example "The dog and the cat" gives "the"
  example "b a" gives "a"
  example "" gives ""
  s0: lower = text.lower t
  s1: words = text.split_words lower
  s2: empty = seq.is_empty words
  s3: give "" when empty
  s4: distinct_words = seq.distinct words
  s5: sorted_uniq = seq.sort distinct_words
  s6: counts = seq.tally words
  s7: counted = seq.each sorted_uniq with to_counted counts
  s8: start = new counted_word word = "", count = -1
  s9: best = seq.fold counted start with better_word
  s10: give best.word
end most_common_word

record test_state
  n : int
  d : int
end test_state

unit check_divisor
  takes s : test_state
  gives loop of test_state and bool
  s0: d2 = s.d * s.d
  s1: done_prime = loop.done true
  s2: give done_prime when d2 > s.n
  s3: rem = s.n % s.d
  s4: done_composite = loop.done false
  s5: give done_composite when rem == 0
  s6: next_d = s.d + 1
  s7: next_s = new test_state n = s.n, d = next_d
  s8: again = loop.again next_s
  s9: give again
end check_divisor

unit is_prime
  takes n : int
  gives bool
  s0: give false when n < 2
  s1: start = new test_state n = n, d = 2
  s2: res = repeat start with check_divisor limit n else false
  s3: give res
end is_prime

unit primes_up_to
  takes n : int
  gives seq of int
  shrinks n
  s0: give [] when n < 2
  s1: less = n - 1
  s2: prev = primes_up_to less
  s3: prime = is_prime n
  s4: out = when prime then seq.append prev n else prev
  s5: give out
end primes_up_to

unit find_sorted
  why "find the index of x in sorted xs, or -1 if absent"
  takes xs : seq of int
  takes x : int
  gives int
  example [1, 3, 5] 3 gives 1
  example [1, 3, 5] 2 gives -1
  s0: found = seq.find xs x
  s1: pos = match found
      on some i then i
      on none then -1
  s2: give pos
end find_sorted

unit digit_sum
  takes n : int
  gives int
  shrinks n
  example 0 gives 0
  example 123 gives 6
  example 405 gives 9
  s0: give 0 when n <= 0
  s1: d = n % 10
  s2: rest = n / 10
  s3: sub = digit_sum rest
  s4: out = d + sub
  s5: give out
end digit_sum

record collatz_state
  current : int
  steps : int
end collatz_state

unit step_collatz
  why "one step of the Collatz sequence"
  takes s : collatz_state
  gives loop of collatz_state and int
  s0: give loop.done s.steps when s.current <= 1
  s1: is_even = s.current % 2 == 0
  s2: next_val = when is_even then s.current / 2 else s.current * 3 + 1
  s3: next_steps = s.steps + 1
  s4: next_state = new collatz_state current = next_val, steps = next_steps
  s5: give loop.again next_state
end step_collatz

unit collatz_steps
  why "number of steps until n reaches 1 in the Collatz sequence"
  takes n : int
  gives int
  example 1 gives 0
  example 6 gives 8
  s0: start = new collatz_state current = n, steps = 0
  s1: total = repeat start with step_collatz limit 1000000 else 0
  s2: give total
end collatz_steps

unit count_by_length
  takes words : seq of text
  gives map of int to int
  s0: lengths = seq.each words with text.length
  s1: counts = seq.tally lengths
  s2: give counts
end count_by_length

record search_state
  xs : seq of int
  target : int
  i : int
  j : int
end search_state

record search_result
  found : bool
  i : int
  j : int
end search_result

unit search_step
  takes st : search_state
  gives loop of search_state and search_result
  s0: n = seq.length st.xs
  s1: not_found = new search_result found = false, i = 0, j = 0
  s2: done_empty = loop.done not_found
  s3: give done_empty when st.i >= n - 1
  s4: opt_i = seq.at st.xs st.i
  s5: val_i = maybe.or opt_i 0
  s6: opt_j = seq.at st.xs st.j
  s7: val_j = maybe.or opt_j 0
  s8: sum = val_i + val_j
  s9: hit = new search_result found = true, i = st.i, j = st.j
  s10: done_hit = loop.done hit
  s11: give done_hit when sum == st.target
  s12: advance_j = st.j + 1 < n
  s13: next_i = when advance_j then st.i else st.i + 1
  s14: next_j = when advance_j then st.j + 1 else st.i + 2
  s15: next_st = new search_state xs = st.xs, target = st.target, i = next_i, j = next_j
  s16: again = loop.again next_st
  s17: give again
end search_step

unit two_sum
  takes xs : seq of int
  takes target : int
  gives seq of int
  example [2, 7, 11, 15] 9 gives [0, 1]
  s0: n = seq.length xs
  s1: give [] when n < 2
  s2: start = new search_state xs = xs, target = target, i = 0, j = 1
  s3: max_rounds = n * n + 2
  s4: fallback = new search_result found = false, i = 0, j = 0
  s5: res = repeat start with search_step limit max_rounds else fallback
  s6: out = when res.found then [res.i, res.j] else []
  s7: give out
end two_sum

unit word_key
  takes w : text
  gives text
  s0: cs = text.chars w
  s1: sorted_cs = seq.sort cs
  s2: k = text.join sorted_cs ""
  s3: give k
end word_key

unit add_to_groups
  takes groups : map of text to seq of text
  takes w : text
  gives map of text to seq of text
  s0: k = word_key w
  s1: empty_list : seq of text = []
  s2: existing = map.get_or groups k empty_list
  s3: updated = seq.append existing w
  s4: res = map.put groups k updated
  s5: give res
end add_to_groups

unit sort_words
  takes ws : seq of text
  gives seq of text
  s0: res = seq.sort ws
  s1: give res
end sort_words

unit group_first_word
  takes g : seq of text
  gives text
  s0: m = seq.first g
  s1: first_word = match m
      on some w then w
      on none then ""
  s2: give first_word
end group_first_word

unit anagram_groups
  takes words : seq of text
  gives seq of seq of text
  s0: start : map of text to seq of text = map.empty
  s1: grouped = seq.fold words start with add_to_groups
  s2: raw_groups = map.values grouped
  s3: sorted_each = seq.each raw_groups with sort_words
  s4: sorted_groups = seq.sort_by sorted_each with group_first_word
  s5: give sorted_groups
end anagram_groups

record bin_state
  val : int
  digits : text
end bin_state

unit bin_step
  why "one step of extracting binary digits from least to most significant"
  takes s : bin_state
  gives loop of bin_state and text
  s0: done = loop.done s.digits
  s1: give done when s.val == 0
  s2: rem = s.val % 2
  s3: bit = int.to_text rem
  s4: next_digits = text.concat bit s.digits
  s5: next_val = s.val / 2
  s6: next_state = new bin_state val = next_val, digits = next_digits
  s7: cont = loop.again next_state
  s8: give cont
end bin_step

unit to_binary
  why "convert a non-negative integer to binary text representation"
  takes n : int
  gives text
  example 0 gives "0"
  example 5 gives "101"
  s0: give "0" when n == 0
  s1: start = new bin_state val = n, digits = ""
  s2: res = repeat start with bin_step limit 70 else ""
  s3: give res
end to_binary

unit second_largest
  why "give the second largest of the different values in xs, or fault if fewer than two"
  takes xs : seq of int
  gives int or fault
  example [1, 2, 3] gives 2
  example [5, 1, 5, 2] gives 2
  s0: unique = seq.distinct xs
  s1: count = seq.length unique
  s2: give fault "fewer than two distinct values" when count < 2
  s3: sorted = seq.sort unique
  s4: rev = seq.reverse sorted
  s5: rest = seq.drop rev 1
  s6: second = seq.first rest
  s7: val = match second
      on some x then x
      on none then give fault "fewer than two distinct values"
  s8: give val
end second_largest

  totals : seq of int
end accum

unit step_running_total
  takes acc : accum
  takes x : int
  gives accum
  s0: s = acc.sum + x
  s1: t = seq.append acc.totals s
  s2: out = new accum sum = s, totals = t
  s3: give out
end step_running_total

unit running_total
  takes xs : seq of int
  gives seq of int
  example [1, 2, 3, 4] gives [1, 3, 6, 10]
  s0: empty : seq of int = []
  s1: init = new accum sum = 0, totals = empty
  s2: final = seq.fold xs init with step_running_total
  s3: give final.totals
end running_total

unit rotate_left
  why "rotate xs to the left by k places"
  takes xs : seq of int
  takes k : int
  gives seq of int
  example [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] 2 gives [3, 4, 5, 1, 2]
  s0: n = seq.length xs
  s1: give xs when n == 0
  s2: shift = k % n
  s3: head = seq.drop xs shift
  s4: tail = seq.take xs shift
  s5: out = seq.concat head tail
  s6: give out
end rotate_left

record bracket_state
  ok : bool
  stack : seq of text
end bracket_state

unit is_bracket
  takes ch : text
  gives bool
  s0: b0 = ch == "(" or ch == ")"
  s1: b1 = ch == "[" or ch == "]"
  s2: b2 = ch == "{" or ch == "}"
  s3: yes = b0 or b1 or b2
  s4: give yes
end is_bracket

unit is_open
  takes ch : text
  gives bool
  s0: yes = ch == "(" or ch == "[" or ch == "{"
  s1: give yes
end is_open

unit matches
  takes open : text
  takes close : text
  gives bool
  s0: round = open == "(" and close == ")"
  s1: square = open == "[" and close == "]"
  s2: curly = open == "{" and close == "}"
  s3: yes = round or square or curly
  s4: give yes
end matches

unit step
  takes state : bracket_state
  takes ch : text
  gives bracket_state
  s0: failed = not state.ok
  s1: give state when failed
  s2: open = is_open ch
  s3: pushed = seq.concat [ch] state.stack
  s4: push_state = new bracket_state ok = true, stack = pushed
  s5: give push_state when open
  s6: empty = seq.is_empty state.stack
  s7: bad_state = new bracket_state ok = false, stack = state.stack
  s8: give bad_state when empty
  s9: top = seq.first state.stack
  s10: matches_open = match top
      on some prev then matches prev ch
      on none then false
  s11: popped = seq.drop state.stack 1
  s12: next_stack = when matches_open then popped else state.stack
  s13: next_state = new bracket_state ok = matches_open, stack = next_stack
  s14: give next_state
end step

unit balanced_brackets
  takes t : text
  gives bool
  example "([{}])" gives true
  s0: all_chars = text.chars t
  s1: brackets = seq.keep all_chars with is_bracket
  s2: empty_stack : seq of text = []
  s3: start = new bracket_state ok = true, stack = empty_stack
  s4: final = seq.fold brackets start with step
  s5: empty = seq.is_empty final.stack
  s6: balanced = final.ok and empty
  s7: give balanced
end balanced_brackets

record point
  x : int
  y : int
end point

unit step_pos
  takes pos : point
  takes move : text
  gives point
  s0: nx = when move == "R" then pos.x + 1 else when move == "L" then pos.x - 1 else pos.x
  s1: ny = when move == "U" then pos.y + 1 else when move == "D" then pos.y - 1 else pos.y
  s2: next = new point x = nx, y = ny
  s3: give next
end step_pos

unit final_position
  takes moves : text
  gives seq of int
  example "RUR" gives [2, 1]
  s0: chars = text.chars moves
  s1: start = new point x = 0, y = 0
  s2: end_pt = seq.fold chars start with step_pos
  s3: out = [end_pt.x, end_pt.y]
  s4: give out
end final_position

unit digit_to_roman
  takes d : int
  takes one : text
  takes five : text
  takes ten : text
  gives text
  s0: two = text.concat one one
  s1: three = text.concat two one
  s2: seven = text.concat five two
  s3: eight = text.concat five three
  s4: out = when d == 1 then one
      else when d == 2 then two
      else when d == 3 then three
      else when d == 4 then text.concat one five
      else when d == 5 then five
      else when d == 6 then text.concat five one
      else when d == 7 then seven
      else when d == 8 then eight
      else when d == 9 then text.concat one ten
      else ""
  s5: give out
end digit_to_roman

unit roman_numeral
  takes n : int
  gives text
  example 1994 gives "MCMXCIV"
  s0: thousands_digit = n / 1000
  s1: rem1 = n % 1000
  s2: hundreds_digit = rem1 / 100
  s3: rem2 = rem1 % 100
  s4: tens_digit = rem2 / 10
  s5: ones_digit = rem2 % 10
  s6: thousands = when thousands_digit == 1 then "M"
      else when thousands_digit == 2 then "MM"
      else when thousands_digit == 3 then "MMM"
      else ""
  s7: hundreds = digit_to_roman hundreds_digit "C" "D" "M"
  s8: tens = digit_to_roman tens_digit "X" "L" "C"
  s9: ones = digit_to_roman ones_digit "I" "V" "X"
  s10: ans = text.join [thousands, hundreds, tens, ones] ""
  s11: give ans
end roman_numeral

unit is_duplicate_entry
  takes entry : pair of int and int
  gives bool
  s0: count = entry.second
  s1: yes = count > 1
  s2: give yes
end is_duplicate_entry

unit entry_key
  takes entry : pair of int and int
  gives int
  s0: k = entry.first
  s1: give k
end entry_key

unit duplicates
  takes xs : seq of int
